daily_km_assumption.explanation: Daily_KM equals Daily_Trips x Route_KM (within 1%) on 137 of 186 routes; it differs on the other 49. 44 of those coincide with the routes whose Route_KM was replaced by an externally researched distance in v3.4.4 (the a02 km-substituted flag), so Daily_KM probably kept the pre-substitution length (inferred from the overlap, not traced in the engine); the other 5 are unexplained here. PLAN_TRIPS_X_LENGTH is the internally consistent basis.

observed_km_per_bus_day.source: a06_deadhead.json observed_day (a13 duty model, driver GPS)

plan_km_per_bus_day.note: Daily_KM / Fleet_Required, with Fleet_Required including the 1.15 spare ratio

daily_km_assumption.reading: The plan costs a 16-hour day for every bus, minibuses included, at ~320 km per bus; today's observed duty is ~99 km. PLAN is therefore an upper bound and OBSERVED a lower bound; neither is a costed duty roster, and no crew count is derived.

service_day_hours_both_directions.derivation: Daily_Trips x Headway_Min / 60 per route; Daily_Trips counts departures in both directions

engine_emission_factor_check.basis: 12 m e-bus kWh/km (ITDP 2022, verified) x CEA v22.0 FY2025-26 grid factor (verified); the 9 m figure is not sourced and is not used in this check
engine_emission_factor_check.breakeven_note: the grid factor (g CO2/kWh) at which the engine's 30 g/km would be right for the stated 12 m kWh/km range; compare with the CEA FY2025-26 range 675-705 g/kWh
engine_emission_factor_check.grid_basis_caveat: national-average grid factor; J&K's supply mix differs and no state-level factor is in the repo, so this is an order-of-magnitude check, not a measured error
engine_emission_factor_check.note: Engine Phase-4 Emissions_GCO2_Daily is not used; diesel constants are unverified (see constants_table).
engine_emission_factor_check.understatement_factor_note: mid-range ratio (kWh/km and grid factor each at the midpoint of their ranges)

envelope.note: lowest end of OBSERVED to highest end of PLAN (SRTU_MORTH lies between them); PROVISIONAL, cost and diesel constants unverified

exclusions: crew (driver/conductor) wages as a separate line: not modelled and no crew count derived from any input; whether the per-km rate embeds crew is unverified
vehicle purchase or lease (capital for the ~400 vehicles above today's fleet and for replacement): not modelled; whether the per-km rate embeds capital recovery is unverified
charging infrastructure and grid connection for the SSCL e-bus backbone
fare revenue: figures are gross operating cost, not net subsidy
seasonal or winter service reduction: 365 operating days assumed (upper bound)
headline: PROVISIONAL (grid factor, 12 m e-bus energy and SRTU utilisation are sourced; diesel economy and per-km cost rates are not). Annual gross operating cost for 1011 buses (HPV 187 / MPV 754 / LPV 70), each class costed on its own constants: INR 513–859 crore on the plan's own kilometres (16-hour day, a ceiling) and INR 165–276 crore on observed duty (a floor); CO2 55–82 kt and 17–26 kt. Pricing the 754 MPVs as full-size buses (the earlier treatment) would give INR 642–1,054 crore on the plan basis. Crew as a separate line, vehicle capital, depots and charging infrastructure are excluded.

sourced_gcc_cross_check.basis: all HPV vehicle-km at the 12 m e-bus GCC range, all MPV km at the 9 m range, LPV km at the module's own (unverified) minibus range; i.e. what the plan would cost if every bus were procured on an e-bus GCC
sourced_gcc_cross_check.caveat: press-sourced (CESL tender results, Outlook Business / Mercom 2023) plus one ITDP figure; a different question from the diesel-oriented module range, so reported beside it and not substituted for it
